## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. State anything not tested.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] Tests/checks relevant to the change pass.
- [ ] No secrets, raw datasets, backups, or generated model artifacts are included.
- [ ] Database/configuration changes include upgrade and rollback notes, if applicable.
- [ ] Demonstration data and unavailable capabilities remain clearly labeled.
